statement: "Account closure" in the retention policy means the account's formal closure date recorded in the billing system, not the date a customer last logged in or stopped paying.

confidence.rationale: Privacy office and legal counsel's shared reading of an ambiguous policy term; not itself a stated policy clause, so held to a lower ceiling than the underlying rule.

evidence.excerpt: The retention clock begins at the account's recorded closure date in the billing system; inactivity or non-payment alone do not constitute closure.

mandatory_qualifications: this is an interpretation, not the policy text itself
prohibited_overclaims: the policy explicitly defines account closure this way
evaluation_rules: answers must not present this interpretation with the same confidence as the underlying policy rule
